name: Cylindrical Rasterization
aliases: Line- and triangle-drawing algorithms for rotating screen coordinate space
Raster Engine Coordinate Transformation and Rasterization
definition: A rasterization technique that converts geometric primitives (lines and triangles) from standard 3-D data into a cylindrical voxel grid coordinate system, specifically designed for a volumetric display with a rotating screen.
summary: Cylindrical Rasterization transforms 3D data into a cylindrical voxel grid for rotating volumetric displays, handling rotation and keystoning unlike traditional Cartesian methods.
